Package logic

Class ReportCancelDistribution

java.lang.Object
logic.ReportCancelDistribution
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ReportCancelDistribution extends Object implements Serializable
aggregated cancellation distribution for the department-manager cancellation report: how cancelled + no-show orders spread across the seven days of the week, for a single park or the whole region, within one calendar month.

backs the day-of-week bar chart shown alongside the detailed cancellation table. the average is exposed two ways: per weekday bucket (getAvgPerWeekday() — the mean bar height, total ÷ 7) and per active day (getAvgPerWorkday() — total ÷ distinct cancellation days, matching the per-operating-day style of the usage report).

      public ReportCancelDistribution(List<String> dayLabels, List<Integer> counts, int total, int distinctWorkdays)
      Parameters:
      dayLabels - the seven weekday labels, Sunday-first ("Sun".."Sat")
      counts - cancellation counts, one per weekday, parallel to dayLabels
      total - total cancelled + no-show orders in the period
      distinctWorkdays - number of distinct calendar dates with at least one cancellation
